I have an idea for future fan projects, focusing on the silly, weird, chaotic side of SKZ and Stays. 

It seems like fan projects are always heartfelt and very emotionally driven messages, love. 

What if we match their energy with our own crazy Stay energy? We’ve seen how creative we are with edits and memes. Let’s get weird and watch them react to it on stage. Let’s make them feel the same joy we feel watching SKZ code. Let them get to know us more.
P.s.Here
are some photos I took in Chicago.
